claims.claim: Sachin Tendulkar announced a partnership with OpenAI on September 28, 2026, to explore everyday uses of ChatGPT such as planning family trips.
claims.episode_span: Cricket icon Sachin Tendulkar posted on X that he is partnering with OpenAI to explore what else ChatGPT can do beyond answering questions. He shared that the chatbot already helped him plan a recent family trip by suggesting ideas and handling details.
claims.source_title: Sachin Tendulkar announces partnership with OpenAI, says ‘interesting things’ are coming up
claims.supporting_quote: In a post on X on Monday, September 28, Tendulkar wrote, “I’m excited to announce my partnership with OpenAI. We have some interesting things coming up, and I can’t wait to share them with you.”
